title: Опоры двигателя и глушитель
purpose: Engine mounts and the rear exhaust; what is not on the list.
differs_from_en: Welding: the Russian shop welds exhausts (a crack, a bracket, a flex pipe); it is mechanical work under the 30-day warranty and has no list price. The English shop does not weld. No body welding: the company does no body work.
A Russian line: the shop does not cut out catalytic converters and reflash the engine.
new_facts: Exhaust welding is done at the flagship, priced by time with no list price.
Removing a catalytic converter is refused.
